📘 1️⃣ What is Management?

Management is the process of planning, organizing, leading, and controlling resources to achieve goals efficiently and effectively.

👉 Key idea: Getting work done through others

📘 2️⃣ Functions of Management
🔹 1. Planning
Setting goals and deciding how to achieve them
Types:
Strategic (long-term)
Tactical (medium-term)
Operational (short-term)
🔹 2. Organizing
Arranging resources and tasks
Assigning responsibilities
🔹 3. Staffing
Hiring the right people
Training and development
🔹 4. Directing (Leading)
Guiding and motivating employees
Leadership + communication
🔹 5. Controlling
Monitoring performance
Comparing with standards
Taking corrective actions
📘 3️⃣ Levels of Management
🔹 Top Level
CEO, Directors
Long-term decisions
🔹 Middle Level
Managers
Implement plans
🔹 Lower Level
Supervisors
Day-to-day operations
📘 4️⃣ Principles of Management (Henri Fayol)

By Henri Fayol

Key principles:

Division of Work
Authority & Responsibility
Discipline
Unity of Command
Unity of Direction
Scalar Chain
Equity
Stability of Tenure
📘 5️⃣ Scientific Management (F.W. Taylor)

By Frederick Winslow Taylor

Key ideas:

Time study
Motion study
Standardization
Improve efficiency
📘 6️⃣ Motivation Theories
🔹 Maslow’s Hierarchy of Needs

By Abraham Maslow

Levels:

Physiological
Safety
Social
Esteem
Self-Actualization
🔹 Herzberg’s Two-Factor Theory
Hygiene factors → Salary, working conditions
Motivators → Achievement, recognition
📘 7️⃣ Leadership
Types:
Autocratic
Democratic
Laissez-faire
Good Leader Qualities:
Communication
Decision-making
Emotional intelligence
📘 8️⃣ Decision Making
Steps:
Identify problem
Generate alternatives
Evaluate alternatives
Choose best option
Implement
Review
📘 9️⃣ Communication
Types:
Formal
Informal
Barriers:
Language issues
Misunderstanding
Noise
📘 🔟 Organizational Structure
Types:
Functional Structure
Divisional Structure
Matrix Structure
📘 1️⃣1️⃣ Management Skills
Technical Skills
Human Skills
Conceptual Skills
📘 1️⃣2️⃣ Coordination
Integrating activities of different departments
Ensures smooth functioning
📘 1️⃣3️⃣ Control Process
Set standards
Measure performance
Compare
Correct deviations
📘 1️⃣4️⃣ Key Terms
Efficiency → Doing work with minimum cost
Effectiveness → Achieving goals
Productivity → Output/Input
